item.title: Report Alleges Democratic Plot Against Fetterman
Missouri AG Asks Supreme Court to Reinstate Redistricting Map
item.description: Missouri's attorney general filed an emergency appeal with the U.S. Supreme Court to restore a congressional map previously supported by former President Trump.

item.title: Alabama's Oldest Resident Turns 112; Public Invited to Help Celebrate
Pentagon Leak Investigation Details Surface in Media Reports
item.description: The Pentagon conducted polygraph tests on dozens of military personnel to determine who leaked sensitive information to the press, according to reports.
